heroSection.title: Privacy Policy
heroSection.text: Your privacy is important to us. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

introduction.heading: Introduction
introduction.text: Livelihood Development International Initiatives (LDII) is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, use our services, participate in our programs, or interact with us in any way.
introduction.text2: By accessing or using our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not access or use our services.
introduction.text3: This Privacy Policy applies to all information collected through our website (ldiinitiatives.org), mobile applications, email communications, and any related services, sales, marketing, or events (collectively, the "Services").

informationWeCollect.heading: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.text: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you:
informationWeCollect.item: Register for our programs or services
informationWeCollect.item2: Make a donation or financial contribution
informationWeCollect.item3: Subscribe to our newsletter or communications
informationWeCollect.item4: Contact us with inquiries or feedback
informationWeCollect.item5: Apply for employment or volunteer positions
informationWeCollect.item6: Participate in surveys, events, or conferences
informationWeCollect.text2: The personal information we collect may include: full name, email address, phone number, mailing address, date of birth, employment information, educational background, financial information (for donations), identification documents (where required), photographs and videos (with consent), and any other information you choose to provide.
informationWeCollect.text3: When you access our Services, we automatically collect certain information about your device and usage patterns, including:
informationWeCollect.item11: Pages visited and time spent on pages
informationWeCollect.text4: We may receive information about you from third parties, including partner organizations, social media platforms (if you connect your accounts), payment processors, background check providers (for employment), and publicly available sources. This information is used to supplement the data we collect directly from you and to verify the accuracy of your information.

howWeUseYourInformation.heading: How We Use Your Information
howWeUseYourInformation.text: We use the information we collect for various legitimate purposes, including:
howWeUseYourInformation.item: Administering and delivering our programs and services
howWeUseYourInformation.item3: Providing support and responding to inquiries
howWeUseYourInformation.item5: Conducting research and analysis to improve our services
howWeUseYourInformation.item6: Sending newsletters, updates, and program information
howWeUseYourInformation.item7: Notifying you about events, conferences, and opportunities
howWeUseYourInformation.item8: Responding to your questions and requests
howWeUseYourInformation.item9: Providing important notices and policy updates
howWeUseYourInformation.item10: Sending fundraising appeals and donation receipts
howWeUseYourInformation.item11: Processing donation pledges and acknowledging gifts
howWeUseYourInformation.item16: Complying with legal obligations and regulations
howWeUseYourInformation.item20: Responding to legal requests and proceedings

informationSharingAndDisclosure.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosure
informationSharingAndDisclosure.text: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information in the following circumstances:
informationSharingAndDisclosure.text2: We may share information with trusted partner organizations, implementing partners, and collaborators who assist us in delivering programs and services. These partners are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only for the purposes we specify.
informationSharingAndDisclosure.text3: We engage third-party service providers to perform functions on our behalf, including payment processing, data analysis, email delivery, hosting services, customer service, and marketing assistance. These providers have access to personal information only as needed to perform their functions and are obligated to maintain confidentiality.
informationSharingAndDisclosure.text4: We may disclose your information if required by law, court order, or governmental regulation, or if we believe disclosure is necessary to protect our rights, protect your safety or the safety of others, investigate fraud, or respond to government requests.
informationSharingAndDisclosure.text5: In the event of a merger, acquisition, reorganization, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you via email or prominent notice on our website of any change in ownership or use of your personal information.

dataSecurity.heading: Data Security
dataSecurity.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:
dataSecurity.item: Encryption of data in transit and at rest using industry-standard protocols
dataSecurity.item2: Secure servers and firewalls to protect our systems
dataSecurity.item3: Regular security assessments and vulnerability testing
dataSecurity.item5: Employee training on data protection and privacy
dataSecurity.item6: Incident response procedures for security breaches
dataSecurity.item7: Regular backups and disaster recovery plans
dataSecurity.text2: However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
dataSecurity.text3: In the event of a data breach that affects your personal information, we will notify you and relevant authorities as required by applicable law, and take appropriate steps to mitigate any harm.

yourRightsAndChoices.heading: Your Rights and Choices
yourRightsAndChoices.text: Depending on your location and applicable laws, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
yourRightsAndChoices.text2: You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you and to receive a copy of that information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
yourRightsAndChoices.text3: You have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information. You can update your information by contacting us directly or through your account settings.
yourRightsAndChoices.text4: You have the right to request deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions such as legal obligations, ongoing programs, or legitimate business purposes.
yourRightsAndChoices.text5: You can opt out of receiving marketing communications from us by clicking the "unsubscribe" link in our emails or contacting us directly. Please note that you may still receive transactional or administrative communications.
yourRightsAndChoices.text6: You can control cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our Services.
yourRightsAndChoices.text7: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided at the end of this policy. We will respond to your request within the timeframe required by applicable law.

internationalDataTransfers.heading: International Data Transfers
internationalDataTransfers.text: LDII operates globally and may transfer your personal information to countries other than the one in which you reside. These countries may have data protection laws that differ from those in your country.
internationalDataTransfers.text2: When we transfer personal information internationally, we implement appropriate safeguards to ensure your information receives adequate protection, including:
internationalDataTransfers.item: Standard contractual clauses approved by relevant authorities
internationalDataTransfers.item2: Data processing agreements with third parties
internationalDataTransfers.item3: Compliance with applicable data protection frameworks
internationalDataTransfers.item4: Ensuring recipients provide adequate protection measures
internationalDataTransfers.text3: By using our Services, you consent to the transfer of your information to Canada and other countries where we operate.

childrenSPrivacy.heading: Children's Privacy
childrenSPrivacy.text: Our Services are not directed to children under the age of 13 (or the applicable age of consent in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children without parental consent.
childrenSPrivacy.text2: For our youth programs, we obtain appropriate parental or guardian consent before collecting information from minors. Parents and guardians have the right to review, modify, or delete their child's information.
childrenSPrivacy.text3: If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child without proper consent, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.

dataRetention.heading: Data Retention
dataRetention.text: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.
dataRetention.text2: The retention period depends on various factors, including:
dataRetention.item: The nature of the information and why we collected it
dataRetention.item2: Legal, regulatory, tax, or accounting requirements
dataRetention.item3: Ongoing program participation or donor relationships
dataRetention.item4: Legitimate business purposes such as fraud prevention
dataRetention.item5: Your consent or requests for deletion
dataRetention.text3: When we no longer need your information, we will securely delete or anonymize it in accordance with our data retention policies and applicable laws.

thirdPartyLinks.heading: Third-Party Links and Services
thirdPartyLinks.text: Our Services may contain links to third-party websites, applications, or services that are not operated by us. This Privacy Policy does not apply to those third-party services.
thirdPartyLinks.text2: We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third parties. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party services before providing your personal information.
thirdPartyLinks.text3: When you interact with third-party services through our platform (such as social media sharing buttons or payment processors), those third parties may collect information about you subject to their own privacy policies.

changesToPrivacyPolicy.heading: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToPrivacyPolicy.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. When we make changes, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy.
changesToPrivacyPolicy.text2: For material changes that significantly affect your rights or how we use your information, we will provide prominent notice through our website, email, or other appropriate channels before the changes take effect.
changesToPrivacyPolicy.text3: We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information. Your continued use of our Services after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

contactInformation.heading: Contact Us
contactInformation.text: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
contactInformation.text10: We will respond to your inquiry within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

acknowledgment.bold: By using our Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
acknowledgment.text: If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, please do not use our Services.
